You can set up Teammates on Perplexity to monitor and manage the market orders for you.

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Jeff Grimes (@jeffgrimes9); megjelent: 2026-11-07T16:14:09+00:00; link: https://x.com/jeffgrimes9/status/2119101107935059969; média: videó, 86 másodperc]
I set up a Market Monitor teammate on Perplexity that manages dozens of agentic trading triggers.

I initialized it with the Robinhood plugin and a skill to define my risk tolerance and investing goals.

With that context, it's able to turn a simple instruction like "Buy a $5 SPY call when the put/call ratio spikes" into a personalized automation.

Results: 2 fills in 140 hourly checks, Oct 7 ($801C, P/C 1.65 vs 1.48) and Nov 5 ($788C, 1.77 vs 1.72).
